correctness.rationale: Unsigned-incidence decomposition provides exact real eigenspaces, PBH restriction gives the exact implication, and odd-unicyclic column independence is proved by signs along graph components. Complement cut bounds isolate precisely the balanced six-vertex obstruction. Small-order cases and labelled generating function are established algebraically. Bounded exact-finite-field checker results for all minimum-cardinality subsets through n=7 support, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The central design problem asks exactly WHICH minimum-size independent input sets work. The theorem answers for every triangular graph size with an odd-cycle pseudoforest criterion, detects a counterintuitive six-vertex exception where the dominant eigenspace is visible yet controllability fails, and counts all optimal designs by a natural rooted-tree generating function. These features supply structural and enumerative value beyond applying a known eigenvalue multiplicity formula.
